test_title: PYST 70: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. A sits third to the left of D. D sits to the extreme right. Only two people sit between A and F. B is an immediate neighbour of F. Only one person sits between C and D. G is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who sits between B and A?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) D sits to the extreme right.

2) A sits third to the left of D.

3) Only two people sit between A and F.

4) B is an immediate neighbour of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46df9e8113a6c8c6990fa3f4a64b2f37a3ea3674c83796671d6de8c5a726d8c8.png] 

5) Only one person sits between C and D.

6) G is not an immediate neighbour of A.

And, E will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533cff0afde1f0b5d41730df4f87b6f00643dc20c7fdc1f03dd27dd3f2486e7c.png] 

Here, "E" sits between B and A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
